tools.name: companies_profile
tools.description: Full profile of one UK company from Companies House: status, industry (SIC with plain description), accounts and confirmation statement due dates and overdue flags, current directors with their other active appointments, owners (persons with significant control), last 10 filings, charges and insolve

tools.name: companies_search
tools.description: Search UK companies by name on Companies House: best matches with company number, status, type, incorporation date and town/postcode. Costs $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: companies_officer
tools.description: Every UK company a person is or was an officer of (director, secretary, LLP member): search by name or Companies House officer id; returns each match's appointments with company, role, dates and company status. Costs $0.02 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: companies_new
tools.description: Up to 10 newly registered UK companies (Companies House) filtered by town, postcode or industry, with director, website check and email details. Costs $0.10 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: companies_overdue
tools.description: Up to 10 UK companies with overdue (or soon-due) Companies House accounts, with director and email details. Leads for accountants. Costs $0.20 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: companies_changes
tools.description: Director appointments, resignations and owner (PSC) changes at up to 20 UK companies since a date, from Companies House. Costs $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: companies_changes_feed
tools.description: New UK director appointments, resignations and owner (PSC) changes from the last 24 hours across all companies, filtered by town, postcode, industry and change type. Up to 100 rows, refreshed daily from Companies House. Costs $0.10 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: companies_changes_feed_sample
tools.description: Free: up to 3 rows from the daily UK director and owner changes feed, with the same filters as companies_changes_feed. Try before you pay.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "companies_officer" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Every UK company a person is or was an officer of (director, secretary, LLP member): search by name or Companies House officer id; returns each match's appointm…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: companies_new · Public sink: companies_new, companies_overdue.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: companies_new · Public sink: companies_new, companies_overdue

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
